title: FairLens: Benchmarking Fairness in Vision–Language Models for High-Stakes Decision-Making

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision-Language Model (VLM) fairness by pairing face images of different genders with high-stakes questions and measuring demographic parity, logical soundness, demographic association for unsupported roles/statuses, and open-ended textual bias using an LLM-as-a-judge.

Measuring disparities in VLM responses by presenting face images across different racial groups and assessing adverse outcome parity, stereotype associations in multiple-choice questions, and implicit biases in free-text generation evaluated by an LLM judge.

Comparing VLM judgments across different age bands (young, middle-aged, senior) using real face images to evaluate demographic parity gaps, unsupported appearance-based inferences, and open-ended response bias in high-stakes domains.
